title: Although, However, Nevertheless
title_ar: لكن، ومع ذلك، وبالرغم من كده
gist_ar: محاضرة في أربع خطوات: من غير روابط الخطاب، السامع مش هيقدر يعيد بناء شكل الحجة.

before_listening.en: A lecture made in four announced moves, one of which is a concession. Listen for the CONCLUSION and how he signals it.
before_listening.ar: محاضرة في أربع خطوات معلنة، واحدة منها تنازل. ركّز على الخلاصة وإزاي أشار لها.

segments.speaker: Lecturer
segments.text: I want to make an argument in four moves, and I want to signal each move as I make it, because the signalling is the lesson. First, the claim. Discourse markers are not decoration. 'However' is not a more formal 'but'. It performs a different act: it tells the listener that what follows will not merely differ from what preceded, but will outweigh it. Second, the evidence. When we removed the markers from recorded lectures and played them to students, comprehension of the individual sentences was unaffected. Recall of the argument's direction fell by roughly forty per cent. The students could tell you what had been said. They could not tell you which side the speaker was on. Third, and this is the concession, which I am flagging deliberately, the effect is smaller in writing. Readers can go back. Listeners cannot. So it is possible to write reasonably well while using markers carelessly, which is why many fluent writers are poor lecturers. Nevertheless, and here is the fourth move, the conclusion is stronger than the concession. If your listener cannot reconstruct the shape of your argument, you have not made an argument; you have produced a sequence of true sentences. And notice what I did just then. I said 'nevertheless', and you knew, before you heard any of the content, that the concession was about to be overruled. That is the whole mechanism, and it cost me one word.

options: Discourse markers matter more in writing than in speech
Without markers a listener cannot reconstruct the argument's shape, so no argument has been made

questions.q: What happened when the markers were removed from recorded lectures?
questions.q_ar: إيه اللي حصل لما شالوا الروابط من المحاضرات المسجّلة؟
options: Sentence comprehension held up, but recall of the argument's direction fell
Both sentence comprehension and recall fell equally

questions.q: What is the concession he flags?
options: That discourse markers turn out to be only decoration after all, as critics claim
That the effect is smaller in writing, because readers can go back
That lecturers are usually poor writers

questions.q: What does he say 'however' does that 'but' does not?
questions.q_ar: قال إن 'however' بتعمل إيه و'but' مبتعملهوش؟
options: It signals that what follows will outweigh what preceded
It is simply the more formal and polished version of the word but
It marks the end of the argument
